items.source_title: Expectation of a random submanifold: the zonoid section
items.title: Zonoid-section formulae for expected volumes and oriented currents of general z-KROK random submanifolds
core_obligations: Given the cited zero-dimensional Kac–Rice formula, Adler–Taylor/Nash normal-field construction, ordinary zonoid calculus and standard measure/conditioning facts, the remaining author problem is a general-codimension expectation formula under the stated z-KROK hypotheses. The author transports Jacobian-weighted weak conditional continuity through transverse pullback and independent products, intersects with auxiliary normal Gaussian fields to reduce the positive-dimensional integral to the discrete Kac–Rice case, and recovers the original density by the geometric Gaussian wedge contraction. This supplies the continuous expected-volume/current representation,including compact-support integrability and the author orientation convention,rather than merely renaming a standard density. Count the complete body Theorems7.1/7.7 representingMainTheoremA with theirAlphaFormula andclosure proof chain as one H2 unit;the14legacytechnicalrecords,AF/BMapplications andlocal functorial identities arenot separate independentcounts.
